  5. Bibliothèque nationale de France — Le tombeau de Couperin, piano — Composition July 1914–November 1917; all six dedications; premiere by Marguerite Long, Salle Gaveau, 11 April 1919.. Accessed 2026-10-17.
  6. Coline Miallier — Le Tombeau de Couperin, Orchestre national de Lyon — Notes dated 25 and 27 November 2021: each movement remembers a friend killed at the front; historical dance forms; separate 1919 orchestration.. Accessed 2026-10-17.
  7. Eric T. Williams — Le tombeau de Couperin, Kansas City Symphony — Programme, 5–⁠7 April 2024, printed pp. 5–⁠7 (PDF pp. 7–⁠9): wartime service, 1 October 1914 letter, Charlot, Deluc and Dreyfus, Couperin forlane transcription.. Accessed 2026-10-17.
